name: P11
title: Hypertension Management Pathway
description: The patient completes a general health questionnaire twice a day and measures blood pressure. If blood pressure is between the defined low and high thresholds, the practitioner is alerted urgently; if it exceeds the high threshold, the emergency team is alerted with stat priority. The patient takes ramipril 2.5 mg once daily. Every six months, the patient attends a cardiology specialist follow-up visit.
